unit: run + native curve + reentry regime established by the unchanged reentry_regime_reset between qualified vectors

1.name: stateful preservation
1.workload: one promotion per native generation; supplied bounded slots, never more than existing one hydration worker per dispatch

2.name: preservation plus fill hysteresis
2.soft: hold after one moderate observation; cancel after two consecutive distinct observations; severe deterioration cancels immediately; no deadline extension

3.name: canonical softening
3.eligibility: evaluate only if Grade-A forward executable outcomes support replicated improvement across run clusters; otherwise not evaluated

selection: accept only demonstrated unique-opportunity improvement with measurable loser/downside/workload safeguards; unknown does not pass; ties retain simpler baseline
probe: not evaluated without qualification-to-executable-entry and scale observations
outcome_labels: no forward executable observation means UNKNOWN; qualification is not a winner; cancellation is not a zero-return trade
